FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
When the handbook uses Department, it means the Department of Transportation acting itself or through authorized representatives. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
When the handbook uses Division, it means the Division of Motor Vehicles. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A02
An electric vehicle draws its propulsion from an electric motor and a battery charged by an outside power source. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A02
A fuel-cell electric vehicle powers its electric motor using a hydrogen fuel cell. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A02
An express highway is a State or Interstate route designed particularly for through traffic. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A02
An Individualized Education Program serves a person eligible for specialized education. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A02
An identification card may be used as valid proof of identity. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A02
The motor vehicle definition covers self-propelled vehicles designed for roadways while excluding farm tractors and off-highway vehicles. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A02
The National Driver Register records drivers with suspended or revoked licenses and drivers convicted of serious traffic offenses. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A02
Motor-vehicle agencies consult the National Driver Register to avoid licensing problem drivers. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A02
A non-plug-in hybrid combines a conventional-fuel combustion engine with an electric motor whose battery cannot receive power from an external source. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A02
An off-highway vehicle is a motor-driven vehicle capable of traveling across natural terrain without a road or trail. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A03
An owner includes the legal titleholder and a buyer paying over time who already has the immediate right to possession. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A03
A plug-in hybrid combines a conventional-fuel combustion engine with an electric motor and an externally rechargeable battery. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A03
The handbook uses railroad crossing as another name for a highway-rail intersection. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A03
Registration includes both the registration card and the vehicle’s registration plate. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A03
The handbook uses road with the same meaning as highway. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R18 | anchor: A03
A safety zone is an officially marked highway area reserved exclusively for pedestrians. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R19 | anchor: A03
The SAVE program checks whether USCIS documents are authentic. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R20 | anchor: A03
The Secretary is the head of Delaware’s Department of Transportation. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R21 | anchor: A03
A street is a highway located in a city or suburban district. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R22 | anchor: A03
A three-point turn reverses a vehicle’s direction by 180 degrees on a narrow street through a left turn, a reverse movement to the right, and a final right turn. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R23 | anchor: A03
A trailer lacks its own motor and is designed to carry passengers or property while another motor vehicle pulls it. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R24 | anchor: A03
A two-way cycle track is physically separated and carries cyclists in both directions along one side of a road. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R25 | anchor: A03
The vehicle definition excludes human-powered devices, rail-bound devices, electric trackless trolley coaches, electric personal assistive mobility devices, and off-highway vehicles. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]
